# dna product

Product catalogue and prices (TLDs, SSL, products).

## dna product info

```
dna product info <product-name> [flags]
```

Show the price of a product for an order type and period.

productName is a TLD without the leading dot (com, com.tr) or another product name. Example: price
of a 2-year .com renewal.

- **Safety:** read-only (no side effects)
- **API:** `GET /api/v1/products/info`
- **Returns:** `ProductInfoDto`
- **Schema:** `dna schema product.info` (MCP tool: `product_info`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--product-name` | string | TLD without dot (com, net, com.tr) or product name (required; or argument 1 &lt;product-name&gt;) |
| `--order-type` | string | Register, Renew, Transfer, Restore, ... [1=Register, 2=Renew, 3=Transfer, 4=Restore, 5=SubresellerTransfer, 6=Backorder, 7=InternalTransfer, 8=Charge, 9=Trustee, 10=Leasing, 11=Create, 12=OwnerChange] (required) |
| `--period` | int | Years (1-10) (required) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
dna product info com --order-type Renew --period 2
```

## dna product list

| `--sorting` | string | Sorting |
| `--skip-count` | int | Skip count |
| `--max-result-count` | int | Max result count |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |
| `--all` |  | Fetch every page and return all items |

## dna product tlds

```
dna product tlds [flags]
```

List TLDs with prices, periods, rules and required attributes.

The catalogue of TLDs you can sell: register/renew/transfer/restore prices per period, grace
periods, capabilities (privacy, DNSSEC, IDN, trustee) and registry attributes. Not rate limited.

- **Safety:** read-only (no side effects)
- **API:** `GET /api/v1/products/tlds`
- **Returns:** `PagedResultDto<ProductTldListDto>`
- **Schema:** `dna schema product.tlds` (MCP tool: `product_tlds`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

Aliases: `tld`

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--filter-text` | string | Filter by TLD, e.g. com.tr |
| `--currency` | string | Price currency, e.g. USD or TRY |
| `--sorting` | string | Sorting |
| `--skip-count` | int | Skip count |
| `--max-result-count` | int | Max result count |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |
| `--all` |  | Fetch every page and return all items |

**Examples**

```bash
dna product tlds --filter-text com.tr -o json
# TLDs that support DNSSEC
dna product tlds --all --jq '.items[] | select(.isDnssecAvailable) | .name'
```
